self.heading: Your data
self.hint: Everything Calendry holds about you: profile, roles, group memberships, sessions, unavailability, preferences, exam requests, API tokens, calendar links and your own audit trail. A GDPR Right to Access request, self-service.

tenant.heading: Data export
tenant.description: Every Person, login, Group, Room, Offering, Session, exam request and Constraint this institution owns, in one download.
tenant.intro: For a departing institution taking its data with it, or answering a Right to Access request that spans more than one person. A single Person's own record can be exported from their own page instead; this is everything at once.
